keycloak_names.name: Names from Keycloak
turnOn: The registration form fills in the first and last name stored from Keycloak.
Without them, it fills in a display name only when it has at most two words.
stops: The registration form goes back to splitting the display name into first and last name.
keeps: First and last names are still stored at every Keycloak login.
Registrations already made keep their names.

prefill_answers.name: Remembered registration answers
turnOn: Admins can mark a text question as asking for the registrant's Telegram handle or dietary restrictions.
The registration form prefills those answers from the user's saved registration details, and offers to remember new answers.
The profile settings page shows the registration details for editing.
stops: Answers are no longer prefilled and the registration form no longer offers to remember them.
Registration details can no longer be saved or edited.
keeps: Questions keep their Telegram or dietary restriction marking and work as ordinary text questions.
Users can still delete the registration details they saved.
